meta.name: generative-ui
meta.description: Designing interfaces where AI generates UI components dynamically.

copy.tagline: 用AI动态生成界面组件，快速搭建交互原型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速生成动态UI组件来加速设计流程
copy.tagline_en: Generate UI components dynamically with AI for rapid prototyping
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate dynamic UI components to speed up your design workflow

howto.what: Claude 会动态生成界面元素（如表单、图表、布局等），而不仅仅是返回文字。
howto.when: 当你需要查看表格、图表等结构化数据，或要求展示仪表盘、交互式表单等界面时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个销售数据仪表盘
say.note: Claude 会生成包含图表和指标的仪表盘界面。

say.text: 用表格对比这些产品的参数
say.note: Claude 会将数据以表格形式展示。

howto.what_en: Claude dynamically generates UI elements (forms, charts, layouts, etc.) instead of only responding with text.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need structured data displayed visually (tables, charts), request an interface like a dashboard, or require interactive elements like forms.

say_en.note: Claude generates a dashboard with charts and metrics.

say_en.text: Compare these products in a table
say_en.note: Claude displays data in a table format.
